source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Ιωάννης Οσιομάρτυρας ηγούμενος Μονής Μοναγρίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and does not carry the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The entry is one sentence and names its authority, Saint Nikodemos; it gives no century, no emperor and no year, so there is no `dates` object, and the monastery of Monagria is the only place, so `locations` is left out. The page adds under «Ιερά Λείψανα» that a piece of his skull is at the monastery of the Panagia Amasgou in Cyprus. The corpus keeps many men of this name and none of them an abbot of Monagria. No hymn is printed.
